name: Healthy Life Agritec Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2019, Healthy Life Agritec Limited is in the business of trading milk, live poultry and 
fresh meat products[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:
a) Dairy:[1]
Milk, Milk Powder, Milk Cream, Yogurt, Butter, 
Cheese
b) Bakery:[2]
Bread, Buns, Croissant
c) Juices:[3]
Apple, Orange, Mango, Mixed Fruit

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.94%
Company has a low return on equity of 9.85% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 55.6 to 67.4 days.
